main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). A premier Victorian provincial track featuring a spacious 1,995m circumference, 24m width, and a long 400m home straight. Exceptionally fair layout that rewards genuine stayers and balanced mid-field pressers ('P'). Lone speed can occasionally hold if the track is playing firm and uncontested, but closers ('Swoopers') get ample room in the straight.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair barrier distribution overall. The 1600m chute provides a massive 800m straight run before the first turn, giving wide-drawn runners plenty of time to find cover without burning early energy. Shorter sprint chutes (1000m/1100m) place a slight premium on inside stalls (1–5) or early tactical speed.

handicapping_angles.long_400m_straight_fairness: Do not penalize back-markers or stalkers purely for wide draws over middle distances. Bendigo's 400m straight and wide turns ensure that horses with a strong turn of foot can reel in front-runners.
handicapping_angles.the_1600m_chute_settling_effect: Over 1600m, the 800m straight run to the turn neutralizes barrier penalties. Prioritize raw class, fitness, and distance capacity over gate position.
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_shippers: Bendigo regularly attracts quality horses dropping out of Saturday Melbourne (Flemington, Caulfield, Moonee Valley) open handicaps or Benchmark races. These high-tier class droppers hold a major edge over local provincial regulars (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.spring_and_autumn_carnival_form: During the Grade 3 Bendigo Cup ($500k) in October and Golden Mile ($200k) meeting in April, race quality elevates to Metro/Group grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.
